name: COMBINATION
body: a·u + b·v: fire u a times and v b times. (1, 0) and (0, 1) reach any point.

name: ANY TWO ARROWS
body: Two arrows in different directions can reach the whole plane, even tilted ones.

name: BACKWARDS
body: A negative coefficient fires a thruster backwards: −2·u points the other way.

name: SPAN = A LINE
body: If u and v are on one line, every mix stays on it. The span is that line, not the plane.
